title: PortalTP
description: With the PortalTP modification, you can use the /tep command based on your achievements.
body:
⚡Summary:
With the PortalTP modification, you can use the /tep command based on your achievements.

✨Features:
If a player has an operator (OP), the player does not spend teleportation charges. If a player does not have an operator (OP), the player spends teleportation charges. You can use the /tpbalance command to view your own teleportation charge balance.

❗Required: Fabric API! (Only For Fabric).

🇱🇷Language:
Currently, this modification only supports the EN/RU languages!
